NG: office (raw) — compares the waterfall firm name against the org node directly linked in NextGen. Since ~92% of contacts link to an office rather than a firm, name mismatches are common even when the contact is at the right firm. This view shows raw exposure. NR-F1 here includes many “false” conflicts that resolve when you switch to the firm-resolved view.

NG: firm ↑ (resolved) — compares the waterfall firm against NG’s walked-up parent firm (NG_FIRM_NAME / NG_FIRM_CRD). CRD matching is used when both sides have a CRD, eliminating punctuation/abbreviation false positives. This is the more accurate conflict view. The 34,358 remaining conflicts here are genuine firm disagreements.
